annotation.title_clean: 交通运输部关于印发《港口及其一线人员新冠肺炎疫情防控工作指南（第十二版）》的通知
annotation.title_en: Ministry of Transport Notice on Issuing the Guide for COVID-19 Prevention and Control at Ports and for Frontline Personnel (12th Edition)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 交通运输部 (Ministry of Transport of China)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Transport of the PRC
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Ministry of Transport notice issuing the 12th edition of COVID-19 prevention guidance for ports and frontline workers (pilots, dock workers, boarding personnel), covering protection, closed-loop management, information reporting, disinfection and emergency response. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: High-risk port staff must be vaccinated, registered and under closed-loop management
'X+5' work mode with regular nucleic acid testing
Non-essential boarding of ships is restricted; contact with crews minimized
Ports must report infection information and restrict violating agents for 14 days
Ventilation, disinfection and emergency plans required
